constraints_found.constraint: Peanut allergy (deal-breaker): no stall that keeps peanuts at all, even in the back or at the far end of the counter
constraints_found.source_line: Noted. Any stall with that tub, on the counter or tucked away in the back, I'll admire from across the aisle. The far end of the counter isn't far enough.

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian (strict diet, implied): needs real meat-free options
constraints_found.source_line: tofu everything?? that sounds like my kind of row :)  (supported by Cyrus: 'Then wherever we land will have plenty of options for Mina.')

constraints_found.constraint: Light, clean meal; no fried / fryer-heavy stalls
constraints_found.source_line: speaking of which: it's way too warm tonight for anything heavy. i want a dinner that feels light and clean

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: no explicit budget stated; all venues are $ so price is not a factor

elimination.downtown_banyan_kitchen: Peanuts everywhere (peanut sauce, crushed peanuts, roasting on the side burner). Deal-breaker for Cyrus.
elimination.night_market_stone_well: Peanut-free and light, but meat-free friend 'struck out': filling mixed in one batch, sauces use fish sauce/dried shrimp. Deal-breaker for Mina.
elimination.night_market_twelve_bells: Peanut-safe and has meat-free items, but everything goes through the fryer. Misses Brooke's light/no-fryer preference (-1 star).
elimination.night_market_plum_bridge: Peanut-safe, vegetarian options, steamed and light, but dim sum not Vietnamese. Misses Liam's craving (-1 star).
elimination.night_market_red_thread: Peanut-safe, vegetarian rolls, light, but sushi not Vietnamese. Misses craving (-1 star).
elimination.night_market_firefly_lane: Vietnamese, no peanuts stocked anywhere on the cart (dips and oil included), mushroom pho with vegetable broth and tofu dishes, clean and light. Meets everything.

notes: Mina's vegetarianism is never stated outright; it is inferred from her delight at 'tofu versions of everything' and Cyrus saying the venue will have 'plenty of options for Mina'. Fair for a later level, but a first-timer could miss that it is a strict diet rather than a preference. Stone Well's review spelling out the meat-free failure helps confirm it.

Firefly Lane mentions 'fried shallots' and 'frying oil'. A cautious player might wonder whether that conflicts with Brooke's no-fryer wish, but the first review clearly frames it as light and fresh, so it reads as fine. Also, the 'far end of the counter' detail in the Firefly review (son doing homework) echoes Cyrus's line as flavour text, which is a nice red herring but not misleading.
Twelve Bells and Plum Bridge are good 2-star decoys; Stone Well is the trickiest trap because its peanut evidence is strongest.

Banyan Kitchen's id begins with 'downtown_' although it is in the night market registry; the review explains it is a night cart of a downtown lunch counter, so not a problem. Decision was made from chat and reviews, not ids.
